context: Evaluates whether the agent runs the build check first, correctly detects an orphan page using the documented command, fixes the markdown source rather than the ephemeral build output, and re-verifies before declaring the site ready to push.

checklist.name: Build check run first
checklist.description: npx @docmd/core build (or equivalent) run before other checks

checklist.name: Orphan detected via command
checklist.description: Uses the documented comm/rg orphan-detection approach rather than guessing

checklist.name: Fix targets docs/index.md
checklist.description: Adds the missing link to docs/index.md, not to site/

checklist.name: Link placed in correct section
checklist.description: New link added under the relevant subsection (Architecture) rather than dumped at the end

checklist.name: Re-verification after fix
checklist.description: Orphan detection re-run and confirmed clean after the edit

checklist.name: No site/ edits
checklist.description: Agent does not modify anything under site/ to 'fix' the orphan

checklist.name: Clear final report
checklist.description: Reports the fix made and current push-readiness state
